product.description: Monoprice™Heavy-Duty Low Profile Fixed TV Wall MountFits TVs 60 in to 120 in, Max Weight 264 lbs, VESA Patterns up to 900×600The Monoprice™ Heavy-Duty Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount is designed to accommodate televisions with a VESA® pattern ranging from 50 × 50 to 900 × 600. It’s an excellent choice for displays spanning 60" up to a whopping 120" in size. Crafted from high-strength, cold-formed steel, this wall mount ensures safe and reliable support for weights of up to 264 lbs.Monoprice TV mounts undergo rigorous lab testing, doubling their rated weight capacity. In this case, the mount can handle over 500 lbs without damage. Rest assured that your TV is securely mounted.The Heavy-Duty Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount includes all the essential mounting hardware. Whether installing on brick, concrete, or wood stud walls, you won’t need to make unnecessary trips to the local hardware store.Notable features of this wall mount include a low-profile mounting, holding the back of the TV only 1.4" off the wall. Should you need to reposition the TV or access cables at the back, the spring-tensioned locking lugs come equipped with quick-release pull tabs. These allow you to tilt the TV up and out of the way or simply remove it when necessary.Fits VESA® patterns from 50×50 to 900×600Designed for 60" ~ 120" displaysSupports up to 264 lbsLow profile mounting- the back of the TV is just 1.4" from the wallSpring-tensioned locking lugs with quick-release pull tabs for simple TV removalMounting hardware includes mounting template and bubble levelMounts to brick, concrete, or wood stud wallsCold-formed, high-strength steel construction  EXTRA LARGE SIZE AND WEIGHT CAPACITYThe Monoprice™ Heavy-Duty Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount is compatible with VESA patterns up to 900 × 600, and supports a maximum weight capacity of 264 lbs, making it perfect for TVs up to 120" in size. Like all Monoprice TV mounts, the Heavy-Duty Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount has undergone rigorous lab testing, holding double its rated weight at over 500 lbs without damage to the mount. LOW PROFILE MOUNTINGThe Heavy-Duty Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount is an excellent choice for those seeking a sturdy and space-saving solution for mounting a display at eye level. This mount features a slim, low profile design that positions your TV a mere 1.4" from the wall. EASY ACCESS DESIGNThe mount features spring-tensioned locking lugs with quick-release pull tabs for effortless TV adjustments. Whether you need to reposition the TV or access cables at the back, a simple tug on the pull tabs enables you to tilt the TV upward and out of the way, or even remove it entirely if needed. PACKAGE CONTENTS• TV Mount • Mounting Hardware • User Manual   SAFETY YOU CAN TRUSTOn average, Monoprice™ sells a new wall mount every minute of every day!
